<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 650" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
    <style>
        .wall-outer { fill: #fcfcfd; stroke: #1e293b; stroke-width: 4; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .wall-major { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 2.8; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .wall-inner { fill: none; stroke: #64748b; stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-linecap: square; }
        .door-leaf { fill: none; stroke: #334155; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; }
        .door-swing { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.1; stroke-dasharray: 2.5,2.5; }
        .fixture { fill: #f1f5f9; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1; }
        .fixture-dash { fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 3,3; }
        .rack-aisle { fill: #f8fafc; stroke: #cbd5e1; stroke-width: 1.2; }
        .hall-line { fill: none; stroke: #e2e8f0; stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-dasharray: 4,4; }
        .room-label { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 9.5px; fill: #475569; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; user-select: none; }
    </style>

    <!-- Outer Perimeter (1000 x 550) -->
    <rect x="50" y="50" width="1000" height="550" class="wall-outer" />

    <!-- ==================== WEST WING: ADMIN & STAFF ==================== -->
    <!-- Major Fire-separating Wall along x=280 between Corridor and Warehouse -->
    <line x1="280" y1="50" x2="280" y2="215" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- Double Fire Doors into Warehouse (y: 215..265) -->
    <line x1="280" y1="215" x2="305" y2="215" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 280,240 A 25,25 0 0,0 305,215" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="280" y1="265" x2="305" y2="265" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 280,240 A 25,25 0 0,1 305,265" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="280" y1="265" x2="280" y2="600" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- Server Room: x: 50..210, y: 50..180 (Rack centered at 130, 115) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="180" x2="210" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <!-- East wall of server room with door opening from corridor (y: 115..145) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="50" x2="210" y2="115" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="210" y1="115" x2="180" y2="115" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,145 A 30,30 0 0,1 180,115" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="145" x2="210" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <text x="65" y="75" class="room-label">SERVER ROOM</text>

    <!-- IT Lab: x: 210..280, y: 50..150 with door into corridor (x: 230..260) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="150" x2="230" y2="150" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="230" y1="150" x2="230" y2="120" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 260,150 A 30,30 0 0,0 230,120" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="260" y1="150" x2="280" y2="150" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="228" y="75" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">IT LAB</text>

    <!-- Central Corridor runs continuously from y=150 down to y=480 (x: 210..280) -->
    <text x="245" y="340" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px; fill: #94a3b8; writing-mode: vertical-lr; letter-spacing: 2px;">CORRIDOR</text>

    <!-- Staff Amenities (Lockers & WC): x: 50..210, y: 180..270 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="270" x2="210" y2="270" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Corridor door into Lockers (y: 205..235) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="180" x2="210" y2="205" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="210" y1="205" x2="180" y2="205" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,235 A 30,30 0 0,1 180,205" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="235" x2="210" y2="270" class="wall-inner" />

    <line x1="130" y1="180" x2="130" y2="270" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="145" y="210" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">LOCKERS</text>
    <line x1="50" y1="225" x2="130" y2="225" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="210" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC M</text>
    <text x="65" y="255" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">WC W</text>

    <!-- Breakroom: x: 50..210, y: 270..360 -->
    <line x1="50" y1="360" x2="210" y2="360" class="wall-inner" />
    <!-- Corridor door into Breakroom (y: 295..325) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="270" x2="210" y2="295" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="210" y1="295" x2="180" y2="295" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,325 A 30,30 0 0,1 180,295" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="325" x2="210" y2="360" class="wall-inner" />
    <rect x="55" y="275" width="20" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <text x="85" y="300" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">BREAKROOM</text>

    <!-- Office: x: 50..210, y: 360..480 (Rack centered at 130, 420) -->
    <!-- Corridor door into Office (y: 395..425) -->
    <line x1="210" y1="360" x2="210" y2="395" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="210" y1="395" x2="180" y2="395" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 210,425 A 30,30 0 0,1 180,395" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="210" y1="425" x2="210" y2="480" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="65" y="380" class="room-label">OFFICE</text>
    <rect x="55" y="445" width="45" height="22" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="160" y="445" width="45" height="22" class="fixture" />

    <!-- Conference Room (x: 50..150, y: 480..600) -->
    <!-- Wall between Office and Conference (y=480) with door from office (x: 80..110) -->
    <line x1="50" y1="480" x2="80" y2="480" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="80" y1="480" x2="80" y2="510" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 110,480 A 30,30 0 0,1 80,510" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="110" y1="480" x2="150" y2="480" class="wall-inner" />

    <!-- Wall between Conference and Lobby (x=150) with door from lobby (y: 525..555) -->
    <line x1="150" y1="480" x2="150" y2="525" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="150" y1="525" x2="120" y2="525" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 150,555 A 30,30 0 0,1 120,525" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="150" y1="555" x2="150" y2="600" class="wall-inner" />
    <rect x="65" y="525" width="55" height="38" rx="3" class="fixture" />
    <text x="65" y="505" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">CONF</text>

    <!-- Main Lobby: x: 150..280, y: 480..600 -->
    <!-- Inside Lobby entrance doors into Corridor (x: 220..270 at y=480) -->
    <line x1="150" y1="480" x2="220" y2="480" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="220" y1="480" x2="220" y2="505" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 245,480 A 25,25 0 0,1 220,505" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="270" y1="480" x2="270" y2="505" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 245,480 A 25,25 0 0,0 270,505" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="270" y1="480" x2="280" y2="480" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="180" y="505" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8.5px;">LOBBY</text>

    <!-- Outside Main Entrance Double Doors on South Wall (y=600, x: 195..245) -->
    <line x1="195" y1="600" x2="195" y2="575" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,600 A 25,25 0 0,0 195,575" class="door-swing" />
    <line x1="245" y1="600" x2="245" y2="575" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 220,600 A 25,25 0 0,1 245,575" class="door-swing" />

    <!-- ==================== CENTER: WAREHOUSE & SORTING ==================== -->
    <line x1="280" y1="330" x2="380" y2="330" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="380" y1="330" x2="450" y2="330" class="hall-line" />
    <line x1="450" y1="330" x2="650" y2="330" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="650" y1="330" x2="720" y2="330" class="hall-line" />
    <line x1="720" y1="330" x2="820" y2="330" class="wall-major" />

    <!-- High-Bay Warehouse (rack at 545, 190) -->
    <text x="300" y="75" class="room-label">HIGH-BAY WAREHOUSE</text>
    <rect x="320" y="110" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="320" y="135" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="320" y="210" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="320" y="235" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="600" y="110" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="600" y="135" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="600" y="210" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />
    <rect x="600" y="235" width="180" height="20" class="rack-aisle" />

    <!-- Sorting Area (rack at 545, 465) -->
    <text x="300" y="355" class="room-label">SORTING & DISPATCH</text>
    <rect x="330" y="405" width="170" height="18" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="330" y="525" width="170" height="18" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="600" y="405" width="180" height="18" class="fixture" />
    <rect x="600" y="525" width="180" height="18" class="fixture" />

    <!-- ==================== EAST WING: LOADING DOCKS ==================== -->
    <line x1="820" y1="50" x2="820" y2="180" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="820" y1="180" x2="820" y2="250" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="820" y1="250" x2="820" y2="400" class="wall-major" />
    <line x1="820" y1="400" x2="820" y2="470" class="fixture-dash" stroke-width="2" />
    <line x1="820" y1="470" x2="820" y2="600" class="wall-major" />

    <line x1="820" y1="140" x2="880" y2="140" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="910" y1="140" x2="920" y2="140" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="920" y1="50" x2="920" y2="140" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="880" y1="140" x2="880" y2="165" class="door-leaf" />
    <path d="M 910,140 A 30,30 0 0,1 880,165" class="door-swing" />
    <text x="830" y="75" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">DOCK OFFICE</text>

    <line x1="820" y1="500" x2="920" y2="500" class="wall-inner" />
    <line x1="920" y1="500" x2="920" y2="600" class="wall-inner" />
    <text x="830" y="525" class="room-label" style="font-size: 8px;">BATTERY</text>

    <!-- Staging Area (rack at 920, 325) -->
    <text x="840" y="275" class="room-label">STAGING & DOCKS</text>

    <!-- 5 Dock Bays -->
    <rect x="1000" y="110" width="50" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <line x1="1050" y1="110" x2="1050" y2="160" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <text x="975" y="140" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">D1</text>

    <rect x="1000" y="190" width="50" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <line x1="1050" y1="190" x2="1050" y2="240" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <text x="975" y="220" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">D2</text>

    <rect x="1000" y="270" width="50" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <line x1="1050" y1="270" x2="1050" y2="320" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <text x="975" y="300" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">D3</text>

    <rect x="1000" y="350" width="50" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <line x1="1050" y1="350" x2="1050" y2="400" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <text x="975" y="380" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">D4</text>

    <rect x="1000" y="430" width="50" height="50" class="fixture" />
    <line x1="1050" y1="430" x2="1050" y2="480" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="2.5" />
    <text x="975" y="460" class="room-label" style="font-size: 7.5px;">D5</text>
</svg>
